description: Current monthly PickTrack chart for one genre: the Top 3 tracks with artist, BPM, Camelot key, release date and SoundCloud link, plus the BPM/key of the next locked ranks and a link to the full chart.

genre.description: Chart genre slug. house = House; tech_house = Tech House; deep_house = Deep House; afro_house = Afro House; melodic_techno = Melodic Techno; techno = Techno/Rave; indie_dance = Indie Dance; amapiano = Amapiano; drum_and_bass = Drum & Bass; uk_garage = UK Garage / Speed Garage; dubstep = Dubstep; rnb = R&B; regional = Arabic Afro House; kpop = K-Pop; psy_trance = Psy-Trance; lo_fi = Lo-Fi / Chill Hop; top50 = Top 50 (all genres)

list.description: top100 = most engaged tracks this month (default). hot100 = the next 100, fast risers.

name: get_chart
title: Get a genre chart
